intro.text: An Alethi woman, a little older than Adolin Kholin, and a cousin of Halam, Aratin and Meleran Khal.

items.text: Idani moved to Kholinar around 1164. Adolin had a crush on her and, missing the meaning of her teasing about his sword, bought her a sword as a gift; she grew bored of his hour-long explanation and left without it. Another time he overheard her mocking Renarin and learned that people can be both beautiful and ugly.
In 1175 Adolin told Shallan about Idani as his first crush, and used the story to talk about his relationship with his father.

appearance.text: At fourteen she was beautiful and more mature than most girls her age.
